command:
"=== STEP 1: java for this session ==="
$env:JAVA_HOME = "C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr"
$env:Path = "C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr\bin;" + $env:Path
& "$env:JAVA_HOME\bin\java.exe" -version 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 2
"=== STEP 2: install packages ==="
$sdkOld = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA "Android\Sdk"
$sm = Join-Path $sdkOld "cmdline-tools\latest\bin\sdkmanager.bat"
& $sm --install "platform-tools" "platforms;android-36" "build-tools;36.0.0" 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 6
"=== STEP 3: licenses ==="
1..40 | ForEach-Object { "y" } | & $sm --licenses 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 2
"licenses done"
"=== STEP 4: move SDK to project folder ==="
$sdkNew = "C:\Users\Abdullah G\Desktop\Website\flip-scanner\Android\Sdk"
if(Test-Path $sdkNew){ Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $sdkNew }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Split-Path $sdkNew) | Out-Null
Move-Item -LiteralPath $sdkOld -Destination $sdkNew -Force
"moved"
"=== STEP 5: env vars to new location ==="
[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("ANDROID_HOME", $sdkNew, "User")
[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("ANDROID_SDK_ROOT", $sdkNew, "User")
"env set"
"=== STEP 6: clean temp ==="
Remove-Item (Join-Path $env:TEMP "cmdtools.zip") -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item (Join-Path $env:TEMP "cmdtools") -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
"cleaned"
"=== VERIFY ==="
$smNew = Join-Path $sdkNew "cmdline-tools\latest\bin\sdkmanager.bat"
& $smNew --list_installed 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 10
& (Join-Path $sdkNew "platform-tools\adb.exe") version 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 1
